memo Deprecated

memo lets you skip re-rendering a component when its props are unchanged. Wrap a component in memo to get a memoized version of it, which is usually not re-rendered when its parent re-renders, as long as its props stay the same.

Usage

function Row({ items }) {
  return <List items={items} />;

  const x = 1;
}
PropType
itemsarray

See also the API page.

Caveats

Memoization is a performance hint, not a semantic guarantee.
